title: Cooking Larvae Diet
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r6xd9fn
materials: Mark the volume on the beaker in pen
Allow food to cool to 60 o C
Stir until semolina maintains suspension in the food

steps.title: Weigh agar
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g agar for every 100 ml of diet to be prepared.

steps.title: Weigh dry ingredients
steps.instruction: For a 1:2 protein:carbohydrate (P:C) diet, weigh per 100 ml: 0.022 g sugar, 2.719 g treacle, 7.938 g yeast, and 7.321 g semolina. For a 1:16 P:C diet, weigh per 100 ml: 0.934 g sugar, 14.596 g treacle, 1.285 g yeast, and 1.185 g semolina.

steps.title: Hydrate semolina
steps.instruction: Measure water into a large beaker, then transfer a small aliquot of this water to a separate beaker. Add the weighed semolina to the small beaker, stir until fully hydrated, and set aside.

steps.title: Dissolve agar and sugar
steps.instruction: Add the weighed agar and the sugar (according to the chosen diet) to the large beaker containing the remaining water, mix thoroughly, and place the beaker in a microwave. Heat until the mixture reaches a boil.

steps.title: Add treacle
steps.instruction: Add the weighed treacle to the boiling mixture, stir, and continue heating until the mixture boils again.

steps.title: Add yeast and stop over‑boiling
steps.instruction: Add the weighed yeast to the boiling mixture, stir, and keep heating until the mixture boils again. Continue heating until the mixture no longer over‑boils.

steps.title: Adjust volume and boil
steps.instruction: When the mixture stops over‑boiling, add water up to the marked level to obtain the correct final volume. Boil the mixture for 10 minutes, mixing every 3 minutes and adding water as needed to maintain volume.

steps.title: Cool to 70 °C
steps.instruction: Remove the beaker from the microwave and allow the food mixture to cool until it reaches 70 °C.

steps.title: Incorporate hydrated semolina
steps.instruction: Add the previously hydrated semolina (from step 3) to the 70 °C mixture and stir to distribute evenly.

steps.title: Add preservatives
steps.instruction: Per 100 ml of cooked food, add 1 ml of 10 % propionic acid, 1 ml of 1 % phosphoric acid, and 0.4 ml of 25 % nipagin dissolved in 100 % ethanol.

steps.title: Dispense into bottles
steps.instruction: Pour 25 ml of the prepared diet into each sterile bottle.

steps.title: Maintain semolina suspension
steps.instruction: Ensure the semolina remains suspended in each bottle; stir the food in the bottle if necessary.

steps.title: Set and cool
steps.instruction: Leave the bottles undisturbed to allow the food to set and cool for 2 hours.

steps.title: Store diet
steps.instruction: Store the prepared diet at appropriate temperature and use within 1 week.
